blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Police have arrested a second principal suspect in the killing of 24-year-old Isaac Vergel Viernes, whose remains were found buried beneath cement in Barangay Pahina Central, Cebu City, after the suspect gave a videotaped extrajudicial confession detailing the alleged roles of three men in the killing, according to police. The suspect voluntarily surrendered to police on Wednesday afternoon, October 21, and expressed his intention to confess to his involvement in Viernes’ death. According to the Cebu City Police Office’s (CCPO) second progress report, which Councilor Dave Tumulak sent to the media group on Thursday, October 22, this […]...
